info.title: Laji API
info.description:
## Authentication

This API requires an **Access Token**. To obtain a token:
1. [Send a `POST` request with your email address to the `/api-user` endpoint](https://api.laji.fi/openapi#/API%20user/ApiUsersController_register).
2. An access token will be sent to your email.

Include the token in all requests using the HTTP header: `Authorization: Bearer <ACCESS_TOKEN>`

Here on the API frontpage, you can configure the **Access Token**, **Person-Token**, and **Accept-Language** globally using the **Authorize** button below.

---

## Documentation & Resources

- **Additional API documentation:**
  [https://info.laji.fi/en/frontpage/api/api-laji-fi](https://info.laji.fi/en/frontpage/api/api-laji-fi)

- **OpenAPI / Swagger 3.0 specification (machine-readable):**
  [https://api.laji.fi/openapi-json](https://api.laji.fi/openapi-json)

---

## Support

If you have any questions, contact us at **helpdesk@laji.fi**.

parameters.name: checklist
parameters.description: Include taxa from the specified checklists (defaults to FinBIF master checklist)

parameters.name: informalTaxonGroups
parameters.description: Filter based on given informal groups. Multiple values are separated by a comma (,).

parameters.name: selectedFields
parameters.description: Select fields to include in the result. Multiple values are separated by a comma (,)

parameters.name: checklistVersion
parameters.description: Checklist version to be used. Defaults to the latest version.

parameters.name: invasiveSpecies
parameters.description:
true: Will include only invasive taxa.
false: Will exclude invasive taxa.

parameters.name: finnish
parameters.description:
true: Will include only finnish taxa.
false: Will exclude finnish taxa.

parameters.name: includeMedia
parameters.description: Include media objects in the response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: includeDescriptions
parameters.description: Include description objects in the response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: includeRedListEvaluations
parameters.description: Include red list evaluations in the response. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: includeHidden
parameters.description:
true: Will show hidden taxa
false: Hidden taxa are skipped and their non-hidden children raised up in the tree.

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description:
Sorting field of the species (one of 'taxonomic' | 'scientificName' | 'finnishName') and optional sort order 'desc' | 'asc'.
Order defaults to 'asc'. The sort field and order are separated by a space character.

Defaults to 'taxonomic'

parameters.name: parentTaxonId
parameters.description: Filter based on parent taxon id
